review_basis: Fifth ORVYQ system-owned byte-bound semantic visual-QA round. Each replacement contact sheet was inspected against all current claim-bound uses; any clip valid only as a loose metaphor but misleading for another assigned use was rejected rather than partially approved.

decisions.reason: The contact sheet shows recreational scuba divers inside a rocky cave. It is not an abyssal plain, nodule field, ROV survey, or unoccupied deep-seabed context.

The contact sheet shows a bulk cargo ship loading at a commercial port. It does not show offshore pipe handling, a working marine deck operation, or the rare-earth-mud lifting context required by the contracted uses.
The contact sheet shows a scuba diver over a bright shallow rocky seabed with fish. It does not show a dark benthic survey, persistent extraction tracks, or visible long-term disturbance.
The contact sheet shows barges and dredging or construction activity in a sheltered canal or port. It is not a scientific survey vessel, offshore research crew, or oceanographic equipment operation.

The contact sheet shows a recreational scuba diver in a cave. Because the current uses include factual deep-ocean ecology as well as a closing descent metaphor, it would falsely substitute cave diving for abyssal conditions.
